{{dablink|For other uses of the word "iron," see [[Iron]].}}
The '''iron disc''' is a ''[[ter'angreal]]'' that was stolen from the [[White Tower]] by [[Liandrin's Group of Black Sisters]].

==Appearance==
The disc is seemingly made of simple iron but has been untouched by rust over the years. It is three inches in diameter and is finely engraved with a tight spiral on both sides.{{ref/book|3|25}}{{ref/book|4|11}}

==Use==
It is a [[sleepweaver]]. By channeling spirit into the disk, the user will fall asleep and then enter ''[[Tel'aran'rhiod]]''.{{Ref/book|4|11}}

==History==
It was previously last studied by [[Corianin Nedeal]].{{ref/book|3|25}} This sleepweaver was recovered from the [[Black Ajah|Black Ajah sister]] [[Amico Nagoyin]] in [[Tear]].{{Ref/book|4|11}}{{ref/book|3|55}} [[Elayne]] made many copies of it.
